answer: Histories are stored in beacon, checked in ripple, and harbor makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 19 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 9 epochs. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
